name: sun-cleric-dawnbreak-cone-wide-8452
contract: Dawnbreak 800654 (and its ranks 502496-502499, 504579, 504580) uses DBC implicit target 24
(TARGET_UNIT_CONE_ENEMY_24) with a 12 yd radius. That '24' is the DBC implicit-target id, not an
angle, but Spell::SelectImplicitConeTargets falls back to reading it as a 24 degree cone (+/-12)
when `spell_cone` has no row: a strip 2-4 yd wide at 4-10 yd, matching the report of 'mostly one
target, often none'. The pending SQL (rev_20261027_02_dawnbreak_cone.sql) adds a spell_cone row of
90 degrees (+/-45), the repo's precedent for target-24 spells (Flames of Xoroth,
rev_20260916_13_flames_of_xoroth_cone.sql). The harness places a creature fixture only along the
owner's absolute +x axis, so the angle between the caster and the target is produced by turning the
caster in place (teleport to the same point with a new `o`) instead of moving the target.
A target 30 degrees off the caster's facing falls outside the old +/-12 degree cone (never hit
before the fix) and inside the new +/-45 degree cone (must be hit after it); a target directly
behind (180 degrees) must stay unhit by a frontal cone either way. The 12 yd radius is unchanged.

steps.label: Health before the control cast (facing 0, target straight ahead)
CONTROL: cast Dawnbreak facing the target directly
CONTROL: a target straight ahead is always hit
Turn 30 degrees away from the target
DISCRIMINATING: cast Dawnbreak with the target 30 degrees off facing
DISCRIMINATING: the widened 90-degree cone (+/-45) hits a target 30 degrees off facing, which the old 24-degree cone (+/-12) could not
Turn fully away so the target is behind
CONTROL: cast Dawnbreak with the target behind
CONTROL: a target directly behind is never hit by a frontal cone
